svg.title: coderprint: 604k lines of code in use, of 791k written, all time
svg.desc: 604,313 lines of code in use (430,555 in production, 173,758 in tests), of 791,385 written (all time, charted since 06MAR2026): 1,587 commits across all branches, 43 active days, a longest streak of 23 days, a current streak of 1 day, and 5 languages at 1% or more of the lines of code. They came in 3 bursts of 19k, 56k and 716k lines of code. The bars end on 11OCT2026, the day this panel was drawn. Share of lines of code by language: Rust 42%, Lean 32%, Python 11%, TypeScript 10%, JavaScript 4%, other languages under 1%. Of what was written, 76% is kept.
